result.source: Restoran Mon Ami, Trg kralja Tomislava 26, 10410 Velika Gorica, Croatia (+385 1 6213 333). Investigated: official site monami.hr (homepage + /kontakt), MICHELIN Guide (EN and JP listings), Gault&Millau Croatia, Gastronaut.hr, hrvatskekarta.com (Google review mirror, 1,355 reviews), RestaurantGuru (cross-platform aggregator), Eat Out Zagreb long-form review (Sep 2023), Putni Kofer feature (May 2025), Okusi.hr (Zagreb County tourism board partner listing), moja-djelatnost.hr, Tjedan restorana, Luxury Living Croatia. TripAdvisor direct fetch returned HTTP 403 — its figures come from search-index snapshots, not a direct read. Facebook and Instagram pages returned title-only shells (JS-rendered), so no social metrics were verifiable.
result.summary:
Mon Ami is a family-run seafood-led restaurant on Velika Gorica's main square, open since 1997 and now the highest-rated restaurant in town on every platform checked. It was founded by Božo Ceronja (from Skradin, Dalmatia) and Barica/Barbara Ceronja (a native of Turopolje) — the Dalmatian-meets-continental pairing is literally the founding concept. After Božo's death, son Bruno Ceronja runs it with his mother; head chef Goran Marko Beus has led the kitchen roughly 15-16 years. The restaurant holds a MICHELIN Guide recommendation (sources variously say six or seven consecutive years; 2025 inclusion is confirmed), Gault&Millau Croatia 13.5/20, and has appeared on Croatia's "100 vodećih restorana" list 23 times between 1999 and 2025.

OPENING HOURS: the user's claim is essentially correct but imprecisely worded. Every independent source agrees on Mon 11:00–16:30, Tue–Sat 11:00–23:00, Sunday and public holidays closed. The official site phrases it as "11:00–23:00 svaki dan osim nedjelje i blagdana" with a separate "11:00–16:30 ponedjeljkom" line — the Monday line is an exception that overrides the general one, so a website should present the per-day table rather than the site's own two-line phrasing. Gastronaut additionally lists an annual closure 1–21 August, unconfirmed elsewhere.

Guest sentiment is strongly positive and unusually consistent: fresh fish, service, and value-for-quality. Fish arrives three times a week from multiple fishermen because boats don't sail daily. The recurring complaints are narrow and specific: slow food service when busy, a menu some find limited, and occasional out-of-stock items late in the lunch service. Ratings differ by platform and must not be merged into one number.

Coordinates cluster tightly around 45.7114, 16.0800 across three independent sources — safe for a map embed.

facts.label: Opening hours — Monday
facts.value: 11:00–16:30 (short day; kitchen closes mid-afternoon). Confirmed identically by monami.hr/kontakt, MICHELIN Guide, Gastronaut.hr, hrvatskekarta.com, RestaurantGuru, moja-djelatnost.hr and Okusi.hr.

facts.label: Opening hours — Tuesday to Saturday
facts.value: 11:00–23:00. Same six-plus sources agree, no conflict found.

facts.label: Opening hours — Sunday
facts.value: Closed. Unanimous across all sources.

facts.label: Opening hours — public holidays
facts.value: Closed. Stated on the official site: 'svaki dan osim nedjelje i blagdana'. Only the official site mentions holidays explicitly; aggregators omit it.

facts.label: Hours claim verdict
facts.value: The user's claim is CORRECT in substance. Caveat: the '11:00-23:00 daily except Sunday' phrasing is the restaurant's own site copy and is overridden by the Monday 11:00-16:30 line — a website should render the per-day table, not that sentence, or guests will arrive Monday evening to a closed door.

facts.label: Possible annual summer closure
facts.value: Gastronaut.hr lists a closed period of 1–21 August ('Godišnji odmor'). NOT corroborated by the official site or any other source. Treat as unverified; do not publish without phoning.

facts.label: Latitude / Longitude
facts.value: Approximately 45.71137, 16.07998. Three independent sources cluster within ~40 metres: RestaurantGuru 45.71136860 / 16.07997130; Gault&Millau Croatia 45.711390100195 / 16.079993411045; moja-djelatnost.hr 45.7113453 / 16.0799881. Recommended embed value: 45.7114, 16.0800.

facts.label: Google rating
facts.value: 4.8 / 5 from 1,445 reviews (per RestaurantGuru's mirror of the Google listing). A separate Croatian mirror, hrvatskekarta.com, counts 1,355 reviews with 379 written comments. Counts drift with snapshot date; the 4.8 figure is consistent.

facts.label: TripAdvisor rating
facts.value: 4.7 / 5 from 99–100 reviews, ranked #1 of 21 restaurants in Velika Gorica. NOTE: TripAdvisor blocked direct fetching (HTTP 403); these figures come from search-engine snapshots and a RestaurantGuru cross-reference, not a first-hand read.

facts.label: Facebook rating
facts.value: 4.9 / 5 from 69 recommendations (per RestaurantGuru). The Facebook page itself could not be read directly.

facts.label: Foursquare rating
facts.value: 7.4 / 10 from 21 reviews (per RestaurantGuru).

facts.label: Gault&Millau Croatia
facts.value: 13.5 / 20, listed as a 'Chef's Restaurant', 2026 review year. Head sommelier listed as Zlatko Šimac.

facts.label: Local ranking
facts.value: #1 in Velika Gorica on both TripAdvisor (#1 of 21) and RestaurantGuru (#1 of 59). The differing denominators are each platform's own venue count, not a contradiction.

facts.label: MICHELIN Guide status
facts.value: Listed in the MICHELIN Guide (Croatia) as a recommended restaurant — cutlery symbol, NOT a Star and NOT a Bib Gourmand. Confirmed present in the 2025 guide. Sources disagree on streak length: Eat Out Zagreb (2023) said 'sixth consecutive', a 2025 source says seven, and Okusi.hr (older page) says three. First recommendation was 2018 per Putni Kofer.

facts.label: Founded
facts.value: 1997, in the centre of Velika Gorica. Founders Božo Ceronja (Skradin) and Barica/Barbara Ceronja (Turopolje). Now run by son Bruno Ceronja with his mother.

facts.label: Head chef
facts.value: Goran Marko Beus, in the kitchen roughly 15–16 years, leading a team of about ten.

facts.label: Seating capacity — main room
facts.value: 70 seats (Gastronaut, Tjedan restorana, Luxury Living Croatia). Okusi.hr and moja-djelatnost.hr say 60 — likely counts the separe separately or predates a refit. Use '70 seats' as the headline figure with the 60 figure as a known minor conflict.

facts.label: Private room (separe)
facts.value: Separate booth/room seating 10, suitable for closed business meetings or private gatherings. Consistently reported.

facts.label: Terrace / outdoor seating
facts.value: Yes — terrace with 20 seats, covered and heated in winter (Gastronaut). MICHELIN describes 'a small, welcoming outdoor area available during warmer months'. Gault&Millau describes a more relaxed enclosed terrace as a distinct second space alongside the formal white-tablecloth room.

facts.label: Reservations
facts.value: Recommended ('Rezervacija je poželjna'), and advance notice is requested for larger groups. MICHELIN notes the restaurant handles its own bookings — contact directly. Reservations by phone 01/6213 333.

facts.label: Events and groups
facts.value: Hosts business meetings, private events, weddings, family lunches and themed dinners. Separe for up to 10; full room 70. Larger groups should announce in advance.

facts.label: Card payment
facts.value: Yes. Gastronaut lists Maestro, Visa, MasterCard and Diners Club. Okusi.hr lists only cash and Maestro (older page). RestaurantGuru confirms credit cards accepted.

facts.label: Parking
facts.value: Yes. Okusi.hr lists parking capacity as 5 and 15 (two entries, likely dedicated plus nearby). RestaurantGuru lists parking as a venue feature. No source describes it in detail — it is a central-square location, so street/public parking is likely the practical reality.

facts.label: Pets
facts.value: NOT allowed. Stated explicitly on Okusi.hr: 'Ulaz kućnih ljubimaca nije dozvoljen.'

facts.label: Smoking
facts.value: Not permitted indoors.

facts.label: Children / families
facts.value: MICHELIN tags it 'Family Friendly'. Putni Kofer notes families come at weekends and that there is a park with a playground directly in front of the restaurant, which parents use while sitting on the terrace. No source mentions a dedicated kids' menu or high chairs.

facts.label: Accessibility
facts.value: Wheelchair accessible / accessible entry — confirmed by Okusi.hr, Gault&Millau ('Access for people with disabilities') and RestaurantGuru.

facts.label: Air conditioning
facts.value: Yes (MICHELIN facilities list).

facts.label: WiFi
facts.value: Available (Okusi.hr).

facts.label: Delivery / takeaway
facts.value: Yes — RestaurantGuru lists both. The official site has an 'Online naručivanje' (online ordering) section at monami.hr/online-narucivanje/.

facts.label: Dietary options
facts.value: Vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free dishes offered. The skradinska torta dessert is naturally gluten-free (nut-based, apparently flour-free).

facts.label: Wine list
facts.value: 60–65 labels, predominantly Croatian producers. House wine is a Chardonnay–Graševina cuvée from the Pokuplje subregion, Vukomeričke gorice.

facts.label: Own olive oil
facts.value: The family presses its own extra virgin olive oil (mostly oblica variety) from a grove in Skradin, used across the menu. Won gold with 96.42 points at 'Dani mladih maslinovih ulja' in Vodice. They also sell green olives and olive-leaf tea.

facts.label: Fresh fish sourcing
facts.value: Fish arrives three times a week. Owner Bruno Ceronja works with several fishermen because boats do not sail daily; in summer jellyfish clog the nets and catches drop, hence multiple suppliers. Typical daily catch: škrpina (scorpionfish), brancin (sea bass), kovač (John Dory), swordfish fillets, zubatac (dentex), grouper, black sea bream.

facts.label: Sustainability
facts.value: Holds a Green Destination certificate and a Zagreb County award for sustainable restaurant. Most ingredients sourced within a 100 km radius; employs local staff.

facts.label: Distance from Zagreb Airport (Franjo Tuđman / Pleso)
facts.value: Very close — the airport lies within Velika Gorica's municipal area. Roughly 5–7 km, about 8–12 minutes by car in normal traffic. PUBLIC TRANSPORT (from the restaurant's own site): airport buses run to Velika Gorica's main bus station roughly every 35 minutes, the restaurant is about a 3-minute walk from there, and the fare is around two euros.

facts.label: Distance from central Zagreb
facts.value: Zagreb Airport is ~10 km southeast of Zagreb Central Station; Velika Gorica centre is a similar order of distance. Bus line 290 runs Kvaternikov trg – Velika Gorica – airport, about 30 minutes from Zagreb city centre, every 30 minutes from 04:30 to 00:15 with night service.

facts.label: E-scooters nearby
facts.value: Official site states city electric scooters are available in the immediate vicinity of the restaurant, and links to the Bolt scooter app.

facts.label: Email and web
facts.value: monamihr@gmail.com, www.monami.hr. Mobile: 091 5444 715. Facebook: facebook.com/monamihr. Instagram handle appears as both @monami.hr and @restoranmonami across sources.

Instagram (@monami.hr) returned a title-only shell — no bio, follower count, post count or captions retrieved. Note also that Okusi.hr lists the Instagram handle as @restoranmonami, so there may be two accounts or a handle change. Unverified which is current.
Facebook page returned a title-only shell. The 4.9/5 from 69 recommendations is second-hand via RestaurantGuru and unverified.
The Gastronaut-listed annual closure of 1–21 August is a single-source claim, absent from the official website. Cannot confirm whether it still applies.
Seating capacity conflicts: 70 seats (Gastronaut, Tjedan restorana, Luxury Living) vs 60 seats (Okusi.hr, moja-djelatnost.hr). Unresolved.

MICHELIN recommendation streak is inconsistently reported across sources — three, six and seven consecutive years all appear, depending on article date. Only 'recommended, present in the 2025 guide, first recommended 2018' is safe to publish.

Parking specifics unverified. Okusi.hr's numbers ('5' and '15') are unlabelled fields with no explanation of whether they mean dedicated spaces, nearby public spaces, or something else. No source describes a restaurant car park. Phone to confirm before making a parking claim on the site.
No current menu with prices was found on any accessible source. The prices captured are from the Eat Out Zagreb review of September 2023 and are now two years stale — treat as indicative only.
Current per-review star ratings on Croatian aggregators were not retrievable; hrvatskekarta.com shows review text with reviewer initials only, and no per-review star values.
No confirmation of a dedicated children's menu, high chairs, or baby-changing facilities.

No group/event capacity figure beyond the 10-person separe and the 70-seat room — no information on whether the restaurant does full buyouts, and no stated maximum for weddings despite weddings being mentioned.
No verified data on whether online ordering / delivery is currently active — the 'Online naručivanje' page exists but its live status was not checked.

Exact door-to-door driving distance from Zagreb Airport to Trg kralja Tomislava 26 was not obtained from a mapping service; the 5–7 km / 8–12 min figure is inferred from the D408 road length and the airport's position within Velika Gorica.

dishes.note: The single most-mentioned dish. Owner Bruno Ceronja: 'Crni rižoto od sipe naše je najpoznatije jelo.' Gault&Millau notes the portion is large enough to serve as a main. One dissenting Google reviewer found it overly garlicky.

Meaty, smoky, served with olive oil and rocket; from a farm on southern Pag inaccessible by car.
